title: UPI QR 'refund' scam
blurb: A 'Swiggy support agent' says a refund is stuck and sends a collect request: enter your UPI PIN to receive it. The PIN sends money instead.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello sir, I'm calling from Swiggy customer support regarding your complaint about the wrong order last night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, the order was completely wrong. I asked for a refund.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the refund of 1,340 rupees has been approved, but it is stuck because your UPI ID is not verified in our system.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh. What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am sending a refund request to your PhonePe now. You will see a request for 1,340 rupees. Just accept it and enter your UPI PIN, the amount will be credited instantly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, why do I need to enter my PIN to receive money?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is the new RBI verification process for refunds above one thousand. Every customer does this. Please do it now, the request expires in two minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay... I see the request. It says 'pay 1,340 to Swiggy Refund'.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, that is the refund verification. Enter your PIN and you will get the money back with a bonus coupon.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm entering the PIN now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, it shows failed on my side. Please try once more with the second request I'm sending, for 13,400, it will reverse both.

source: authored for evaluation (paraphrased from public advisories)
